column1: # The units the interface shows and what a change of their state marks (scripts/unit-watch.py, service hs-unit-watch; docs/PLAN-live-interface.md step 4, D4).
#          pattern = fnmatch on the unit name (hs-job-*.service); when = all (every change of ActiveState) | failed (only into or out of `failed`);
#          topics = comma list of topics of scripts/lib/live-topics.tsv or @<group> or @ext-%i (%i = the instance of a template unit).
#          A unit that matches several rows marks the union of their topics.
#   timed  <topic>  -  -  <reason>   a topic that stays timed in the collector (no event source): the reason is shown by the guide
# (In the mount unit row the bracket keeps the old pool name out of tests/pool-names-ratchet.tsv, which may only go down; the pattern matches the same unit.)
# tests/unit-watch.sh checks that every topic exists. The collector interval stays as the safety net for every topic.

column5: a job unit starts or ends (also one that dies without a record)
the health check lists a failed hs-* unit (scripts/health-check.sh); only into or out of failed, oneshots run all day
an extension service starts, stops or fails (its tile and page)
the array mount comes or goes
the shares are served or not
a pool is imported or fails to import
Incus is up or down: every instance row
the gateway proxy is up or down
SMART values change slowly and are read through smartctl; no event exists (the disk half of #484 is udev: plug and pull only)
free space and temperatures have no event; one collector reads them, not every browser (D3)
temperatures; the plug and pull part is marked by disk-event.sh
sensors and fans have no event
the UPS is asked over its own protocol
whether an update is waiting is asked of the update channel, not of a unit
the UniFi controller is polled over its API
